statements.status_notes: CVE-2025-8176 is a use-after-free in get_histogram() in tools/tiffmedian.c of LibTIFF up to 4.7.0, reached when the tiffmedian command-line tool processes a crafted TIFF file (https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/issues/707). Upstream fixed it for LibTIFF 4.7.1 with commits https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/ce46f002eca4148497363f80fab33f9396bcbeda, https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/ecc4ddbf1f0fed7957d1e20361e37f01907898e0 and https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/commit/78397815cdf7e9ad79943e00c3f06a6df9bf45c5 (merge request https://gitlab.com/libtiff/libtiff/-/merge_requests/727), which make tiffmedian stop when a scanline cannot be read and correct the first-row handling in tiffmedian and tiffdither. Debian has not fixed trixie's 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-8176). The DHI tiff package for Debian 13 is built from that Debian version with these upstream changes backported. Its current build, the fixed version in this range, lists CVE-2025-8176 in its shipped changelog, and its tiffmedian program for amd64 and arm64 contains the new scanline-read error path, which the tiffmedian in Debian's own 4.7.0-3+deb13u3 lacks. Builds before the current one are no longer published in the DHI Debian repository and could not be checked, so this range treats them as affected.
